gates.name: project to shared Graphic Knowledge bridge

residuals: No real multi-project reviewed graphic corpus exists yet; N12/TAV07 remains the first pilot producer.
Real TAV07 semantic labels are still pending the project human review gate.
The reference persistence layer is currently SQLite plus content-fingerprinted portable packs; a centralized service is not required for this tranche.
Visual embeddings and neighbourhood-graph similarity are future resolver providers and are not part of the current deterministic affinity resolver.
next_eligible_action: Build SYS-REVIEW-001: system Graphic Review Workspace that combines project evidence with LOCAL/AFFINE/FAMILY/GLOBAL suggestions and persists project specialization decisions.
